2+ years of programming experience in SQL and other languages, tools, and libraries
Ability to develop reusable and modular code to be shared among development teams. Experience in application development, integration, and support across a variety of relational databases.
Design and create MS SSIS packages. Having experience in using most of the tasks in SSIS.

Programming experience in multiple languages and tools, including C#, Python, T-SQL, Reporting Services, Data Transformation Services and Integration Services, Visual Studio, Adobe Acrobat, and XML, R.

Join the Department of Anesthesiology and Perioperative Medicine and play a key role in advancing perioperative analytics through the continued growth of our Perioperative Data Warehouse (PDW), a custom SQL data warehouse that supports administrative, quality improvement, research, and predictive analytics initiatives using data from UCLA Health's Epic platform. Reporting to the Director of Operations and Chief Data Architect for the Center of Excellence for Perioperative Analytics, you will provide database development, technical, and analytical expertise while collaborating with faculty, researchers, and operational leaders.

As a Database Administrator and SQL Developer, you will design, develop, and maintain the department's SQL-based data warehouse, including queries, stored procedures, functions, and supporting documentation. You will help ensure data security, compliance, and system integrity; partner with faculty and staff to support research, operational, and quality improvement initiatives; collaborate with bioinformatics teams to evaluate and prioritize data requests; support multi-center research databases and data integration efforts; and represent the department in cross-functional discussions related to data governance, system enhancements, and warehouse expansion. This is an excellent opportunity for a data professional who is passionate about building innovative solutions that advance research, improve patient care, and support operational excellence.
Note: Skills may be subject to testing.
